name: To Thunder Bluff

meta.previous: Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit (Horde)

summary: After communion in Moonglade, a young tauren druid makes a triumphant return to Thunder Bluff. Having earned the Great Cat Spirit's favor, the initiate goes to Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise to master feline shapeshifting.

sections.title: Return from Moonglade
sections.body: You return to Mulgore after meeting Dendrite Starblaze and the Great Cat Spirit in Moonglade's sacred groves. The communion joins ancient night elven teachings with the tauren's earthen heritage, marking a pivotal milestone in a druid's training.

sections.title: Mastering the Cat Form
sections.body: Turak Runetotem awaits you atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Dendrite guided your communion with the Great Cat Spirit; Turak now teaches the physical change. With the spirit's blessing acknowledged, the elder trainer shares the knowledge to take the cat's swift, predatory shape.

faq.q: Where does this quest begin and end?
aliases: where do i turn this in
to thunder bluff quest turn in
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze gives you this charge in Moonglade's sacred haven. You return to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff to speak with Turak Runetotem.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what do i get from to thunder bluff
faq.answer: It is the concluding transition in the druid trial of the cat. After earning the Great Cat Spirit's blessing in Moonglade, you return to your mentor in Thunder Bluff to learn Cat Form.

Turak Runetotem is a respected elder of the tauren druids on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. He oversees the training and initiation of young Horde druids who seek to harmonize with nature and master their shapeshifting forms.

Dendrite Starblaze is a night elf keeper of the Cenarion Circle who guides visiting druids in Nighthaven, Moonglade. He bridges instruction between ancient kaldorei traditions and tauren practitioners despite factional tensions.

faq.q: What is the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit is an ancient primal entity revered by druids, embodying predatory instinct, stealth, and agility. Druids seeking feline form must pass a trial to earn its blessing and understand its playful and deadly nature.

faq.q: Do Alliance druids have an equivalent task?
aliases: alliance version of to thunder bluff
faq.answer: Yes. Night elf druids undergo a parallel rite in Moonglade, then return to Darnassus to report to their own mentor instead of traveling to the wind-swept mesas of Mulgore.

angles.text: As a druid, you learn from Turak Runetotem to master stealth and claws through this rite.
As a tauren, your journey reconnects you with Cenarion traditions as you carry lessons from Moonglade back to the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.
As a Horde druid, you return to your capital so your growing power can defend your kin. The Cenarion Circle remains neutral.
